title: Hearty Smoky Argentinian Beef Stew
description: A smoky and nutritious post-workout stew featuring almond milk, this Argentinian dish is cooked to perfection in an earthenware bowl, resulting in a rich and glassy jelly-like consistency.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the earthenware bowl over medium heat on the stovetop.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the beef brisket pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and stir to combine.
Pour in the almond milk and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the earthenware bowl with a lid, and simmer for 2.5 hours.
Remove the stew from the heat and let it cool slightly, allowing the flavors to meld together and the liquid to thicken into a rich and glassy jelly-like consistency.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
